narr: Low pressure moved very slowly east from the eastern Pacific across the Mojave Desert, triggering scattered thunderstorms for a few days. Several storms produced flash flooding.
ev: Flash flooding with rapidly flowing water over the roadway along Sandy Point Drive near West Meadview Boulevard in Meadview. The road was undercut by water and exhibiting erosion beneath it.
Vanderslice Road was closed due to significant water and debris over the road from East River Valley Place to East View Point Road, and a man was kayaking down Arizona Avenue.
Video clips from Oatman, AZ, showed fast-flowing water and mud over the Oatman Highway near mile marker 23.
The public reported fast-flowing water and mud crossing over Glen Road just east of Pierce Ferry Road in Meadview.
Mohave County alert gauge camera indicated fast-flowing water over White Hills Road just northeast of Highway 93. Water was over the road for approximately 45 minutes.
Shinarump Drive was closed from Teddy Roosevelt Road to Colorado Road, and Oatman Highway was closed from Indian Wells Trail to Silver Creek Drive.
Temple Bar Road was closed due to flooding.
